Hi Samir / Lisa -

Thanks for reviewing the packet. I'm Neha (Security at Redwood) - looping in to offer quick clarifications that commonly come up from vendor reviews. A few short notes below; happy to expand or hop on a call.

- Report date: Our latest SOC 2 Type II covers the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31; the report PDF includes the attestation date on page 2.
- Data handling: Redwood processes customer data in dedicated inference instances; we do not train on customer data and we offer customer-managed VPC options for private deployments.
- Key management: We support customer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and can provide a diagram of key flows if helpful.
- Logs & retention: Audit logs are available via the Console; retention configurable per contract and we provide export for audits.

If your team has a short questionnaire (CSV/Word), send it over and I can provide annotated responses within 2 business days. Also happy to do a 20-min technical sync - I have availability Thu 8 Apr 1-3pm PT or Mon 12 Apr 9-11am PT.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
